title: General Services Agreement – Lowe Consulting Group, Inc. – Facilities Planning & Management Project - Division of Facilities Planning and Management
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of a General Services Agreement by and between the District and Lowe Consulting Group, Inc., Oakland CA, for the latter to provide Project Labor Agreement (PLA) services, assisting the District with managing labor relations, coordinating the PLA’s innovative workforce development and employment programs, and monitoring and reporting on the efficacy of the PLA, more specifically described in Exhibit A of the Agreement, incorporated herein by reference as though fully set forth, for the Facilities Planning and Management, total not-to-exceed in the amount of $183,810.00, which includes a not-to-exceed amount of $167,000.00, for Basic Services, and a not-to-exceed amount of $16,710.00 for Additional Services, as the selected consultant, with work scheduled to commence on June 27, 2024, and scheduled to last until June 30, 2025.
presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
headline: Hires Lowe Consulting for up to $183,810 to support the district's Project Labor Agreement
summary: Lowe Consulting Group will help the district manage labor relations under its Project Labor Agreement (PLA), coordinate the PLA's workforce development and employment programs, and monitor and report on how well it works. The limit is $183,810, made up of $167,100 for basic services and $16,710 for additional services. The official text lists basic services as $167,000, which does not match the agreement. source_issue: The stated total not-to-exceed of $183,810.00 is $100 more than its two parts as printed, $167,000.00 for Basic Services and $16,710.00 for Additional Services; the attached agreement states Basic Services as $167,100.00.
